name: पाँच रंग
tagline: पाँच तक खिलाड़ी पहले अपनी लाइन बनाने की होड़ करते हैं।
description: ब्राउज़र में पाँच रंग मुफ़्त खेलें: दो खिलाड़ियों के लिए पाँच एक लाइन में, तीन या ज़्यादा के लिए चार। बॉट, दोस्तों या ऑनलाइन।
about: Five Colors is a line game for two to five players. Everyone has stones of their own colour and shape, and takes turns placing one on an empty point of a large grid. The first to make an unbroken line, across, down or diagonally, wins.

Two players need five in a row on a 15 × 15 board, as in Gomoku. From three players on, four in a row is enough, because with more than one opponent to block it, a line is much harder to keep open; with four or five players the board grows to 17 × 17. Blocking matters as much as building: if you don't stop a rival's line, the next player might not either.
You can fill any seat with a bot on one of three levels, play with friends on one device, or play online. A per-move timer keeps games moving when there are several players.
howToPlay: Choose the number of players and who sits where, then start. The first seat moves first and turns go round in order.
On your turn, place one stone on any empty point.
With two players, five stones in an unbroken line win. With three or more players, four in a line win.
Lines count across, down and diagonally.
If the board fills up with no winning line, the game is a draw for everyone.
controls: Phones and tablets: tap a point to see where your stone would go, then tap it again to place it.
Mouse: click a point to place a stone there.
Keyboard: move around the board with the arrow keys and press Enter or Space to place a stone.
Against bots, Undo takes back your last move and the bots' replies.
tips: Watch every player, not just the one after you. A line can grow while two others play.
Block an open line one short of winning at once; you can't count on someone else to do it.
Build where your stones help two lines at once, so one block can't stop both.
With three or more players, threes are already dangerous: four wins.
Stay near the action. Stones far from the others rarely become part of a line.

faq.question: Is Five Colors free to play?
faq.answer: Yes. kefche is free, has no ads, and you don't need an account to play.

faq.question: How long a line do I need?
faq.answer: Five in a row with two players, and four in a row with three or more, since there's more than one opponent to block you.

faq.question: Can bots fill the empty seats?
faq.answer: Yes. Any seat can be a bot on easy, medium or hard, alone or mixed with people on one device.

faq.question: How strong are the bots?
faq.answer: Every bot takes a win and blocks one it sees. Easy picks loosely among good points, medium plays the strongest point, and hard also weighs the next player's best reply.
